atoms.text: Hey guys, how <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> your mock exams go? I think mine <t-blue><u>went</u></t-blue> quite well overall, especially the art exam.

I’m glad yours <t-blue><u>went</u></t-blue> well, and I’m sure you <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> great. I <t-blue><u>had</u></t-blue> issues with several papers, but my friend <t-blue><u>said</u></t-blue> I shouldn’t worry too much as they’re just for practice.
Exactly, we <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> our best, and that’s all that matters! I talked to my French teacher, and he <t-blue><u>said</u></t-blue> it’s normal for this to happen.
What subjects <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> you find hard? I <t-blue><u>had</u></t-blue> difficulty with the history exam, as I only <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> a bit of revision for it.
Oh, for me that <t-blue><u>went</u></t-blue> really well. I <t-blue><u>had</u></t-blue> a tough time with both maths papers though, but I <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> the best I could.

I <t-blue><u>did</u></t-blue> not do the history exam, but we <t-blue><u>went</u></t-blue> through the second maths paper with our teacher in class this morning. Even she <t-blue><u>said</u></t-blue> that we <t-blue><u>had</u></t-blue> more difficult questions than usual!

atoms.text: I’m glad these exams are finally over! I usually love Spanish tests, but it <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> really challenging this time, and I <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> so nervous. How <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> they for you two?
I think they <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> fine in general, although I don’t do Spanish. The geography paper <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> definitely the hardest for me.
That’s a shame, I know that you <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> excited for it, but I completely agree! In class, we <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> all discussing how tough it <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue>.
atoms.sound: That’s a shame. I know you were excited for it, but I completely agree! In class, we were all discussing how tough it was.

atoms.text: Oh, really? My friend <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> really pleased with the paper. It <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> her favourite topic, so maybe the questions <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> easier for her.
I also enjoy the topic, but they <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> so specific, and I <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> confused by the long question at the end!
According to Mr Miller, all the exams <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> more challenging than last year. He <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> reading some of them in our class earlier.
Well, I think we <t-blue><u>were</u></t-blue> as prepared as possible, and it <t-blue><u>was</u></t-blue> an experience to learn from for our real exams next year!
